hypothesis: H33 (GEMSDOE32) scored highest because it is a catalogue-collar-pruned subset of the D2.8 lineage; a visible-only collar prune might beat 0.2778 under hide-and-recover.

mechanism: Under the exact identity DTI = TP/(0.2TP+0.2FP+0.8|G|), a dot is kept iff t/(t+f) > 0.2*DTI. Near-catalogue dots help only if their hit rate is low. Measured: H33 = SOLO-D2.8 minus 2,545 dots within 2 px of mapped faults (0 remain).
named_non_fault_mimic: Catalogue-digitisation and mapping-density effects: pruning near densely digitised traces may track label geometry of the public split rather than a physical rule.

holdout_dti.reason: H33-lineage pruning uses the full catalogue; a fixed prediction masked with the full catalogue is not the hide-and-recover protocol (AGENTS.md rule 5).
